title: Kinematically Constrained Jerk–Continuous S-Curve Trajectory Planning in Joint Space for Industrial Robots
author: Guanglei Wu; Ning Zhang
locator: Section 2.1 distinguishes the standard third-order seven-segment S-curve with piecewise-constant jerk from the fourth-order fifteen-segment model designed for jerk continuity; see abstract and conclusions.
license_or_permission: Publisher page marks the article as open access; consult the publisher CC BY 4.0 licence notice for reuse conditions.
notes: Used only to distinguish bounded, piecewise-constant third-order jerk from fourth-order jerk-continuous trajectory construction. The paper concerns industrial robots and does not establish the repository's synthetic CNC fixture values or machine acceptance criteria.
